        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!(await hasEmailIdentity(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (!(await hasLinkedProfile(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"No code provided\")}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n  const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? (hasEmail ? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n  redirect(redirectTo);\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid type\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid token hash\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Once approved, you will be able to access all protected areas of the application.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if a given pathname is a public route\n * @param pathname - The pathname to check (e.g., '/auth/login')\n * @returns True if the pathname matches a public route, false otherwise\n */\nexport const isPublicRoute = (pathname: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  // Exact match for root route\n  if (pathname === '/') {\n    return true;\n  }\n  // Check if pathname starts with any public route prefix\n  return PUBLIC_ROUTE_PREFIXES.some((prefix) =&gt; pathname.startsWith(prefix));\n};\n\n/**\n * Validates that an email address ends with an allowed CZU domain\n * @param email - The email address to validate\n * @returns True if the email ends with @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz, false otherwise\n */",
